title: Define workforce credential verification and status propagation
requirements:
- State the limits of registration checks versus competence, privileges and task authorisation
- Allow signed or cached verifiable credentials that verify without a registry round-trip
- Replace 'without delay' with risk-based propagation times and failure handling
- Define the verification response: status, source, freshness, assurance, restrictions and failure behaviour
- Define measurable freshness, latency and propagation limits for licence changes
- Make critical status notifications mandatory for authorised subscribers
- Allow recording which credential and privilege authorised a clinical transaction
- Define degraded-mode and emergency fallback with later reconciliation
